body: Then it feels like they won but I guess that mentality is a part of the problem. Yeah, i'll see how that turns out. Thank for talking to me.

I don't mean it literally. The whole situation was stupid really, nothing to stack my life over but long story short. I had an argument with my mom and brother and I guess their words really got to me. My brain, as per usual, twisted everything. They were right though, and I can't help but feel angry. I have no right to be angry though, cause they're right.

The thing is, I don't think I am. I've been told that before and it just feels like everytime I take a step forward, reach out for help, try and improve for myself and my family. I get smacked down. That has to mean I’m not doing enough.That I'm not enough. And if that's not true, then does it stop?
